welcome.headline: Your virtual startup, fully autonomous
welcome.subtitle: The first end-to-end platform for building real products with autonomous AI agents. Define what to build, assign agent teams, and let them ship — from architecture to QA, every department runs itself.
welcome.generateKeyExplanation: This key secures your Agented instance. Store it safely — it won't be shown again.
welcome.generateFailed: Failed to generate API key. Please try again.

bento.productsDesc: Define what you're building. Connect GitHub repos as projects under each product. Your agents take it from there.
bento.teamsDesc: 5 departments, 17 agents. {command} sets direction. {dev} builds. {research} explores. {ops} solves. {qa} validates.
bento.schedulingDesc: Agents move seamlessly between Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, OpenCode — harness sync keeps configs aligned, token usage prediction triggers handoff before limits hit.
bento.harnessDesc: Full harness engineering — config sync, GRD planning, MCP servers, marketplace plugins, custom skills and hooks.

tour.setupCompleteDesc: Your workspace is ready. Here's what you configured:
tour.skipConfirmMessage: You can complete it later from the setup checklist.
tour.pageSlow: This page is taking longer than expected.
tour.restartDesc: Restart the onboarding tour to re-run through workspace setup and account configuration. Your existing configuration will not be affected.

workspace.title: Workspace Directory
workspace.message: Set the root directory where repos will be cloned for your agent teams.

claude.title: AI Backend Accounts
claude.message: Register a Claude Code account. Click 'Add Account' to enter your Anthropic credentials.

codex.title: AI Backend Accounts
codex.message: Register a Codex CLI account for OpenAI integration (optional). Click 'Add Account' to configure.

gemini.title: AI Backend Accounts
gemini.message: Register a Gemini CLI account for Google AI (optional). Click 'Add Account' to configure.

opencode.title: AI Backend Accounts
opencode.message: OpenCode routes through other AI backends. No separate account needed if you registered one above.

monitoring.title: Token Monitoring
monitoring.message: Configure rate limit monitoring to track token usage across your AI backend accounts.

verification.title: Harness Verification
verification.message: Verify the harness integration plugin is configured for deploying skills to your marketplace.

product.title: Create Your First Product
product.message: Products group related projects under a shared context. Click to create your first product.

project.title: Create Your First Project
project.message: Projects track work within a product. Click to add your first project.

team.title: Assign Teams to Project
team.message: Bundled teams with pre-configured super agents are ready to use — just assign them here. You can create custom teams and agents later.

accountWizard.loginOptional: Login is optional — continue if already authenticated
accountWizard.yesHaveAccountDesc: I have credentials and want to register this backend
accountWizard.noSkipDesc: I don't have a subscription or want to set it up later
accountWizard.loginDescription: Authenticate your {backend} account via CLI login.
accountWizard.connectionLost: Connection lost — login may not have completed. Please retry.

yesno.title: Do you have an account?
yesno.message: Pick whether you already have an account on this backend.

name.title: Name this account
name.message: Type a label so you can tell accounts apart later (e.g. "Personal", "Work"). Optional — leave blank to use a default.

email.title: Account email
email.message: Type the email tied to the account. We pass it as a login_hint on the sign-in page.

next.title: Continue to CLI check
next.message: Click Continue — we verify the CLI is installed and move to step 2.

status.title: CLI install check
status.message: Confirm the CLI is installed. If it isn't, the "Install" button will fetch it for you.

path.title: Confirm the config directory
path.message: This is the per-account config dir. We auto-create it on the next step. Click "Customize" if you need a different path.

next.title: Launch the CLI
next.message: Click Continue — we launch the CLI behind the scenes and move to step 3 (Sign in).

preparing.title: Preparing sign-in
preparing.message: The CLI is booting in the background. Wait ~5 seconds for the OAuth URL to appear here; your browser opens automatically.

authorize.title: Authorize in your browser
authorize.message: If your browser didn't open, click this URL. Sign in with the email from step 1 and click Authorize.

paste.title: Paste the authorization code
paste.message: Copy the code from the redirect page and paste it here, then click Send. We verify it for ~5–10 s.

install.title: Install CLIProxyAPI
install.message: If the proxy isn't installed yet, click Install and wait. The proxy lets other tools reach this account through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

start.title: Register with the proxy
start.message: Click Start proxy registration to begin. A browser tab opens for the proxy OAuth.

callback.title: Paste the callback URL
callback.message: Copy the full localhost callback URL from your browser's address bar and paste it here, then click Submit. The redirect page may show "connection refused" — that's expected.

skip.title: Skip the proxy
skip.message: If you don't need the proxy, click Skip to jump to step 5.

review.title: Review
review.message: Check the values you entered. If anything looks wrong, click Back to fix it.

pick.title: Pick a plan
pick.message: Pro, Max, or API. The CLI told us which subscription it found in step 3 — override here if needed.

default.title: Make it the default? (optional)
default.message: Tick to mark this account as the backend's default.

save.title: Save the account
save.message: Click Save — the account is persisted and we move to the Done screen.

add.title: Add another account?
add.message: Click here to add another account on the same backend (e.g. a second Claude account).

nextBackend.title: Move to the next backend
nextBackend.message: Click here to advance the tour to the next backend (Codex / Gemini / OpenCode).

guide.subscription: Do you have a {backend} subscription? Select Yes and enter your account name to get started.
guide.cliInstalled: {backend} CLI is installed ({version}). Review the config directory and continue.
guide.cliNotInstalled: {backend} CLI is not installed. Click "Install CLI" to set it up automatically.
guide.loginCompleted: Login successful! Click Continue to choose your plan.
guide.loginStreaming: Complete the authentication in the terminal below. An OAuth page may open in your browser.
guide.loginIdle: Click "Start Login" to authenticate via {backend} OAuth. Skip if already logged in.
guide.plan: Choose your subscription plan for this {backend} account and save.
guide.done: Account saved! Add another {backend} account or click "Done — Next Backend" to continue.
